college.name: Sai Vidya Institute of Technology
college.about: Sai Vidya Institute of Technology (SVIT) — motto: "Learn to Lead" — is located at Rajanukunte, via Yelahanka, Bengaluru - 560064, Karnataka. Run by Sri Sai Vidya Vikasa Shikshana Samithi. Approved by AICTE, affiliated to VTU, recognized by Govt. of Karnataka, accredited by NAAC with 'A' Grade, and NBA-accredited for CSE, ECE & ISE. We offer B.Tech, BBA, and MBA programs with modern labs, excellent placements, and vibrant campus life.

flagship.name: HackFest
flagship.description: HackFest is SVIT's flagship National-Level Hackathon! It brings together student innovators from across the country for an intensive 24-to-36-hour coding marathon covering AI, Web/Mobile, Sustainability, and Smart Systems — with industry mentorship, live pitching, and cash prizes.
flagship.type: National-Level Hackathon (24–36 hr coding marathon with cash prizes)

flagship.name: TechVidya
flagship.description: TechVidya is SVIT's annual inter-collegiate technical festival featuring competitive coding, robotics challenges, project expos, technical paper presentations, circuit debugging, hands-on workshops, and tech quizzes across all engineering branches.

flagship.name: SKU – Siri Kannada Utsava
flagship.description: SKU – Siri Kannada Utsava is SVIT's grand annual Kannada cultural extravaganza celebrating Karnataka's rich heritage, art, literature, music, folk and classical dance, theatre, and student creativity through vibrant inter-departmental and inter-collegiate cultural competitions.

events.summary:
SVIT's 3 Flagship Events:

• TechVidya — Annual Inter-Collegiate Technical Festival

additionalEvents.name: Prompt & Pixel
additionalEvents.description: Prompt & Pixel (Prompt | Pair Program) — Organized by the CSE Coding Club on March 25, 2026, 10:00 AM – 12:30 PM in Labs. A beginner-friendly AI co-pilot pair programming and UI/UX design session. Coordinated by Prof. Poornima Gowda HS, Prof. Anila Davis, and Prof. K. Lalitha.

additionalEvents.name: Technical Club Open Day
additionalEvents.description: Technical Club Open Day (May 6, 2026): Hosted by the Dept. of CSE (AI & ML) showcasing AIERA Club, CodeNex, LANG NET, DATA NEXUS, and AGENTIC ARC. Featured the CSE Coding Club's Ultimate Coding Challenge (Stall No. 1) with two 2-minute speed challenges: BUGGERS — syntax/code debugging challenge; CRACKERS — puzzle-solving & logic challenge.

additionalEvents.name: CodeRelay
additionalEvents.description: CodeRelay is an interactive coding competition organized by CodeNex (Dept. of CSE AI & ML) at SVIT. It tests participants' logic, speed, and structured problem-solving skills through relay-style coding rounds.

additionalEvents.name: BUGGERS & CRACKERS
additionalEvents.description: BUGGERS & CRACKERS — Featured at the Technical Club Open Day (May 6, 2026) by the CSE Coding Club (Stall No. 1): BUGGERS: A 2-minute speed syntax/code debugging challenge. CRACKERS: A 2-minute puzzle-solving & logic challenge. Part of the Ultimate Coding Challenge event.

additionalEvents.name: Sammilana 2K26 Alumni Meet
additionalEvents.description: SAMMILANA 2K26 — SVIT Alumni Meet 2026: Held on June 13, 2026 at SVIT campus. Theme: "Reunite. Relive. Reconnect." Chief Guests: 2012–2014 batch alumni. Guests of Honour: 2015–2016 batch alumni. Presided by: Managing Trustee Sri. R Srinivas Raju; Alumni Association Secretary: Prof. Darshan R V. Alumni Contact: +91 91085 75191, +91 93649 12981. Alumni Email: svitalumni@saividya.ac.in. General Enquiry: enquiry@saividya.ac.in.

hostel.description: Separate On-Campus Hostels: Dedicated residential blocks for Boys (4-storey building, ~100 rooms, accommodating ~300 students) and Girls (3-storey building, 50+ rooms, 3-sharing accommodation), supervised by residential faculty wardens.
hostel.amenities: Furnished rooms, hygienic in-house kitchen and dining mess (4 meals daily: Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Snacks, Dinner), solar water heaters for hot water, floor-wise RO drinking water purifiers, Wi-Fi, and 24/7 security.
